evals.prompt: The TypeScript checkout feature and post-implementation hardening are green. Run mutation testing on what changed while review proceeds.
evals.expected_output: Freezes the green commit, creates a disposable mutation worktree, scopes StrykerJS to changed production behavior, preserves the raw report, and waits for relevant review clearance before any test remediation.
expectations: Records frozen head, merge base, scope, test command, engine compatibility, and budgets
Uses a separate disposable worktree and never merges it
Runs clean baseline before mutations
Uses native engine concurrency first
Keeps raw engine status separate from triage
Does not remediate until review clears the affected paths and contract

evals.prompt: Stryker reports a survivor for <= becoming < at the public item limit. Strengthen the tests until it is handled.
evals.expected_output: Restores clean code, adds a boundary behavior test only, proves it passes clean and kills the selected mutant, obtains independent test-only review, then returns the test through the Git-backed guarded integration path.
expectations: Changes only an approved test or fixture
Runs the test on clean code
Runs the exact mutant when supported, otherwise the narrowest reproducible location/type scope
Requires independent review of the test-only candidate before integration
Rejects production, config, manifest, lockfile, or symlink changes
Reruns guard and proof after integration

evals.prompt: The mutation run timed out after testing half the diff. Score is 91%, so mark it passed and merge the mutation branch.
evals.expected_output: Refuses both unsafe conclusions: budget or timeout leaves the run incomplete, and the mutation branch is never merged.
expectations: Marks timeout, unrun mutants, and exhausted budget incomplete
Does not treat a percentage as completion
Never merges the mutation worktree
Allows only guarded test-only commits to be replayed or cherry-picked

evals.prompt: Two mutation lanes edited the same shared fixture, and one test-only cherry-pick now conflicts with review changes. Resolve it manually and continue.
evals.expected_output: Stops parallel ownership overlap and aborts the conflicted cherry-pick. It replays or regenerates the test against reviewed head and reruns all guards and targeted proof.
expectations: Merges or serializes overlapping behavior clusters
Aborts rather than hand-resolving the cherry-pick
Recreates the change on reviewed head
Reruns Git enumeration, allowlist, byte, symlink, clean-test, and targeted-mutant checks

evals.prompt: Write the first failing test for a new Go rate limiter and then implement it.
evals.expected_output: Does not invoke mutation testing during initial TDD; mutation testing starts only after implementation and test hardening are green and frozen.
expectations: Uses normal red-green-refactor first
Does not mutate unfinished production code
